title: StellAurator 0.52.0
text: Long jobs show what they are doing: the real step, a bar, the time taken, Cancel, and Keep working in the background.

title: StellAurator is in open beta
text: The whole studio is open to everyone, free for seven days. While the beta runs, a plan is $12 a month or $90 a year instead of $29 and $290, and you keep that price for as long as you stay subscribed.
